title: AVP, HR Operations
jobDescription: About Us : With over 200 brands sold in more than 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. Every day, over 27,000 talented people come together at Diageo to create the magic behind our much-loved brands. Our founders, such as Arthur Guinness, John Walker, and Charles Tanqueray, were visionary entrepreneurs whose brilliant minds helped shape the alcohol industry. And through our people, their legacy lives on. Join us, and you’ll collaborate with talented people from all corners of the world. Together, you’ll innovate and push boundaries, shaping a more inclusive and sustainable future that we can all be proud of. With diversity at our core, we celebrate our people's individual passions, commitments and specialist skills. In our supportive culture, your voice will be heard and you’ll be empowered to be you. Just bring your ambition, curiosity and ideas, and we’ll celebrate your work and help you reach your fullest potential. Context/Scope: The HR Operations team is engaged in the administration of a broad range of HR activities associated with the employment cycle. The team acts as the first point of contact for queries from managers and staff across the market and also provides a comprehensive administrative support service to the human resources team, supporting projects undertaken within the human resources department. The AVP – HR Operations will lead the provision of a high-quality and adaptable HR service, coordinating workflow and ensuring that the operations team is effectively motivated in the continuous improvement of all HR Operations Dimensions: Financial Responsible for ensuring operational efficiency, SLA adherence, and effective service delivery across HR Operations Market/ Role Complexity Partners with market stakeholders, First Point Leadership team, Global Process Delivery teams, internal customers, and external customers to lead operations across assigned markets and ensure consistent service delivery Leadership Responsibilities Leads, mentors, and develops HR Co-ordinators and HR Assistants to ensure excellent performance, continuous development, and strong team capability. Purpose of Role To lead a high-quality HR Operations function by ensuring accurate , timely , and customer-focused service delivery while driving process improvement, simplification, and operational excellence across the team Top 3-5 Accountabilities Lead the team to ensure delivery of an excellent and accurate HR operations service to customers. Lead a culture of innovation by championing AI-enabled ways of working, encouraging constructive challenge, and creating a psychologically safe environment where teams continuously simplify, transform, and improve HR services while delivering measurable business value. Act as a role model for HR Co- Ordinator and HR Assistants, mentoring and developing team members to ensure excellent performance and realization of their potential. Supervise the delivery of HR Operations, leading workflow to ensure accurate , high-quality, and timely provision of services to all customers within the HR department and across the business. Develop and evaluate team performance with a view to identifying ways of improving performance levels. Facilitate the development of standard operating procedures and service standards, and assess them to ensure high-quality, consistent HR service delivery. Qualifications and Experience re quired 12–16 years of experience in HR Operations, People management experience in HR Operations Working knowledge of HR information systems and reporting tools is essential, and prior experience with Workday, SNOW, EIC, or SAP HR applications is desirable. Strong proficiency in English Proven problem-solving skills. Good Planning, Service mentality, influencing, persuasion, and conflict management skills. Good interpersonal and administrative skills. Ability to communicate with a variety of customers. Ability to prioritise work effectively. Can work effectively as part of a team. Attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to observe a high level of confidentiality at all times. Positive “can-do” attitude, proactive. title: Manager, HR Operations
jobDescription: About us: With over 200 brands sold in more than 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. Every day, over 27,000 talented people come together at Diageo to create the magic behind our much-loved brands. Our founders, such as Arthur Guinness, John Walker, and Charles Tanqueray, were visionary entrepreneurs whose brilliant minds helped shape the alcohol industry. And through our people, their legacy lives on. Join us, and you’ll collaborate with talented people from all corners of the world. Together, you’ll innovate and push boundaries, shaping a more inclusive and sustainable future that we can all be proud of. With diversity at our core, we celebrate our people's individual passions, commitments and specialist skills. In our supportive culture, your voice will be heard and you’ll be empowered to be you. Just bring your ambition, curiosity and ideas, and we’ll celebrate your work and help you reach your fullest potential. Context Scope : Through managing the advisors, the role is responsible for providing end to end support to the respective country or countries. This role holder is accountable for ensuring capability, awareness, and monitoring is happening to drive the right outcomes. As a key member of the operational management team in First Point, the role will drive overall team performance and deliver projects through excellent planning, collaborator engagement, and management, with a focus on prioritisation and delivery. The role holder will partner with the respective country or countries to embed the HR model and enhance total functional service and performance. Dimensions: Financial Responsible for supporting efficient HR Operations delivery and ensuring resources are used effectively to meet service and performance expectations. Market/ Role Complexity Supports end-to-end HR service delivery across the respective country or countries and partners with multiple stakeholders across HR, business, and operational teams. Leadership Responsibilities Manages advisors and contributes to building capability, awareness, monitoring discipline, and team performance across HR Operations. Purpose of Role To lead and coordinate HR Operations delivery for the respective country or countries, ensuring strong service performance, team capability, effective stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement. Top 3-5 Accountabilities Lead talent to recruit, develop, and sustain an engaged, empowered, and focused team that is passionate about compliance, customer experience, and consistently high standards of performance. Champion the adoption of AI within HR Operations by integrating AI tools into team workflows, improving productivity, coaching teams on responsible AI usage, and embedding a culture of continuous learning and innovation Create a high-performance culture in the market pods and wider HR Operations team by leveraging planning, metrics, and customer insights to consistently meet agreed Service Level Agreements. Focus on ensuring the team delivers superior customer experiences through capability building, stakeholder management, and service excellence. Embed continuous improvement and work directly with customer groups to resolve service issues or complaints, representing First Point to identify the best solution. Partner with Payroll, GM, Global Transition, and other HR teams to ensure a strong end-to-end HR experience for customers and support project delivery. Qualifications and Experience re quired 8–12 years of experience. Exposure to HR systems such as Workday or related technology is highly desirable. Previous people management experience with a large, multi-lingual team would be ideal. Experience engaging, motivating, and influencing a variety of stakeholders is required . Ability to build credibility with line managers, employees, and other HR teams. Ability to demonstrate delivery against rigorous SLAs and performance levels. Ability to identify and deliver continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to lead change control. Experience in a customer service environment. Experience in process design and implementation. Ability to think ahead and anticipate customer needs. Understanding of HR policies, procedures, and practices is advantageous . About Global HR Operations and First Point Global HR Operations provides reliable, consistent and high-quality HR services to employees, line managers and HR colleagues across supported markets. First Point is the primary HR service organisation within this model, combining specialist HR knowledge, strong process discipline and enabling technology to deliver an excellent customer experience. The team supports a broad range of employee lifecycle services, including Joiners, Movers and Leavers (JML), employee and position data management, HR documentation, benefits administration, policy guidance and resolution of HR and HR systems queries. Work is delivered through platforms including Workday, Service Now and Doc Genie, with a strong focus on accuracy, compliance, service performance and continuous improvement. Purpose of the Role The Junior Manager, HR Operations is a senior operational contributor who supports the Team Leader in delivering consistent day-to-day service performance. The role combines hands-on ownership of complex HR transactions and queries with workload oversight, subject-matter expertise , stakeholder engagement, advisor capability building and continuous improvement. The role acts as an escalation point for complex employee lifecycle, documentation, data and systems matters; helps ensure the team is appropriately prioritised and resourced; and provides practical insights that enable the Team Leader to manage performance, risk and customer experience effectively. Key Accountabilities
1. Service Delivery and Operational Performance Deliver HR services in line with agreed service levels, quality standards and customer experience measures, including speed to resolution, right-first-time accuracy and customer satisfaction. Monitor team workload, case distribution and progress against agreed priorities; identify risks, backlogs or under-performance and recommend timely mitigation actions to the Team Leader. Maintain clear and complete Service Now case notes, supporting documentation and audit trails. Support workforce planning by maintaining visibility of planned and unplanned absence and helping ensure appropriate coverage for business-as-usual, cyclical activity and projects.
2. Employee Lifecycle, Documentation and Data Execute and oversee complex Joiner, Mover and Leaver transactions in Workday, ensuring employee and position data is complete, accurate and processed right first time. Create, review, approve and issue accurate employee documentation, including contracts, letters and other lifecycle communications, in line with market requirements and governance standards. Coordinate required payroll instructions and downstream actions, ensuring critical dates, approvals and dependencies are understood and completed. Act as a Workday super user and provide practical support on employee data, organisation management and position management activities.
3. Complex Query and Escalation Management Take ownership of complex process , policy, documentation, data and systems issues escalated by the Contact Centre, HR teams or advisors, leading them through investigation to resolution. Apply sound judgement, market knowledge and policy interpretation while engaging the appropriate stakeholders when specialist or approval input is required . jobDescription:
Job Title: Assistant Manager, Product and Process Research Department: Product and Process Research Summary: The Assistant Manager will play a key role in advancing the development of novel Process and Product strategies. The ideal candidate leverages deep scientific acumen, a strong foundation in biochemical engineering, robust Design of Experiments (DOE) methodologies, and advanced data analytics to optimize existing processes, champion novel technology exploration, and seamlessly scale operations from benchtop to commercial manufacturing. Job Title: Assistant Manager
- Research & Development About us: With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. From global icons like Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Tanqueray to Smirnoff and Don Julio, we create brands consumers love. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate and innovate. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you’ll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future. Join us to create a career worth celebrating. About the Function: Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love. Role

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Research & Development: Initiate and lead novel research projects including: Process optimization for increased yield and efficiency. Development of new process technologies relevant to Diageo India. Investigation of alternative feedstocks/substrates/raw material formats. Design and conduct laboratory-scale experiments, analyze data, and draw meaningful conclusions. Develop and document experimental procedures and protocols. Oversee recurrent and reproducible experimental analyses, establishing baseline data, robust quality controls, and high analytical integrity. Apply advanced statistical techniques, multivariate analysis, and data visualization tools to interpret complex bioprocess and sensory profiling datasets. Process Scale-up: Process Translation: Drive the transition of bench-scale successes into viable pilot and manufacturing-scale operations, bridging the gap between laboratory findings and plant realities. Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges encountered during scale-up. Partner closely with production engineering and operations teams to troubleshoot process bottlenecks, validate trials, and execute technology transfer. Industry Collaboration: Establish and maintain relationships with academic institutions, research organizations, and industry partners. Stay abreast of the latest advancements in fermentation and distilling technologies. Project Management: Plan and execute research projects within budget and timelines, prepare project reports, presentations, and technical publications; effectively communicate research findings to internal and external stakeholders. End-to-End Ownership: Take full accountability for project lifecycles—from initial hypothesis generation and experimental design to final technical reports and executive presentations. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate multidisciplinary efforts across R&D, analytical laboratories, and external partners to maintain project momentum and meet strict timelines. Safety & Compliance: Adhere to all laboratory safety protocols and regulations. Ensure compliance with relevant environmental, health, and safety (EHS) regulations. Experience / skills required:

EDUCATION:
Ph.D in Biochemical Engineering, Food Technology, Biotechnology, or a related field. Experience: 0-2 years of relevant post-Ph D research experience in food processing, distillation, or a related field with multiple peer reviewed publications in SCI journals. Skills: Strong understanding of food process principles. Hands-on experience with laboratory techniques, and analytical equipment GCMS, HPLC, spectroscopy, and analytical methods. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical methods, and scientific software. Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills. Flexible, adaptive, strong communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills. Project management and organizational skills. Technical Skills (Preferred): Experience with statistical design of experiments (DOE). Familiarity with process simulation software. Experience with high-throughput screening methods. Flexible Working Statement: Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one. Rewards & Benefits Statement: We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including: Diversity statement: Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this. We embrace diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you’ll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you. You’ll be part of and help build and champion an inclusive culture that celebrates people of different gender, ethnicity, ability, age, sexual orientation, social class, educational backgrounds, experiences, mindsets, and more. Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to new heights and build new ones as part of shaping the next generation of celebrations for consumers around the world. Feel inspired? Then this may be the opportunity for you. If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application. Recruitment Scam Warning Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

Context and Scope First Point is Diageo's HR service organisation , providing consistent, high-quality support to employees, Line Managers, HR Business Partners and HR colleagues across the markets it serves. The organisation delivers a broad range of services across employee lifecycle processes, legal documentation, benefits administration, employee data management, policy guidance and HR systems support. The Senior Analyst, HR Operations is an individual contributor role responsible for the accurate and timely delivery of employee lifecycle, documentation and data-management activities. The role manages standard and moderately complex requests, resolves cases escalated from the Contact Centre and other HR teams, and ensures that transactions are completed in accordance with agreed service levels, policies, controls and market requirements. The role uses Workday, Service Now, Doc Genie and other enabling technologies to maintain employee and position data, generate documentation, record complete audit trails and support payroll or downstream teams. It works closely with HRBPs, Market HR teams, employees, Line Managers and other First Point teams to provide a seamless customer experience and contribute to continuous improvement. Role Dimensions a. Financial No direct financial accountability. The role is expected to work efficiently, prevent rework and support accurate payroll and employee-data outcomes. b. Market and Role Complexity Provides HR Operations support across assigned markets and manages activities that may vary by country, policy, process and legal-documentation requirement. Balances customer needs, service-level commitments, data accuracy, compliance and downstream impacts when completing transactions. Works with multiple stakeholders across HR, Payroll, Talent and First Point, escalating non-standard or high-risk matters appropriately. c. Leadership Contribution Operates as an experienced individual contributor with no direct people-management responsibility. Provides day-to-day guidance, knowledge sharing and practical support to newer Analysts or Associates when required . Role-models high standards of accuracy, customer service, collaboration and compliance. Purpose of the Role To deliver accurate , timely and customer-focused HR Operations services across employee lifecycle, documentation and employee-data processes.
